english:
[Music] A thousand thanks to Jesus and the Holy Mother. My name is Soja, I am from Palai. This is my eighth covenant.
This is the third testimony I am sharing at the altar. I am here to speak about a healing my sister’s son, Amal, received.
In 2003, he started experiencing severe back pain. So, in Palai, we consulted many hospitals. Then we took him to the medical college in Kottayam.
When we went there, they said he didn’t have any particular illness, that it was just his habit, and so on. Then they discharged him and let us go.
Afterwards, we again went to a private hospital in Palai. By that time, his whole body had weakened, his tongue had twisted,
and he was in a condition where he couldn’t even sit up. Soon, small twitches started appearing in the hair, on his hands and thighs. Then we took a discharge from there as well.
They told us to take him somewhere else. So immediately, along with my sister, brother-in-law, and everyone, we took him to Amrita. When we reached there,
he was directly put on the ventilator, because he was extremely weak by then. Then they took blood samples for testing, and said the results would be given in the morning.
When the results came, they said it was fourth-stage blood cancer, and that there was nothing more to be done. It was to him that the doctors first told this. They
patted him on the shoulder and walked away. After that, my sister was called and informed about it in detail.
All of us went from home.
The child was in great need. What we received from there was something none of us had ever imagined. I came from home,
and I told my brother-in-law, “In the morning we must go to Kreupasanam. I must go and tell the Mother. No one else can do anything about this.
We don’t even have money for treatment there. We have nothing.
We won’t get anything from anywhere,” I said. In the morning we came here and made a covenant. I told the Mother only two things:
“Please give us back the life of our child. We don’t know where the money for this treatment will come from, and no one can help us.
Mother, whatever is needed, please provide.” Day by day he was facing terrible difficulties and suffering. The doctors said, “Nothing can be done for treatment,
because his sugar has gone above 500. In this condition, no medicines can be given.”
After about six days, they said, “Let’s remove him from the ventilator and shift him to the ICU. Keeping him here won’t make any difference.”
While this was happening, I would prepare small meals for him from home, like dosa, and with the covenant salt I had received from here, I prayed,
recited the declaration of Faith, and gave it to him there. Then I added a pinch of the salt into a glass of water and gave it to him to drink.
Because the doctors had said, “Now there is nothing more that can be done. No medicines can be given. The sugar is staying that high.”
Then I applied the anointing oil on his back and on his forehead, because we had no other help or support. People we knew all said,
“You have no money, nothing at all. Why did you put that child there in the RCC for treatment? You will lose both the boy and the money. You have nothing.”
But we firmly believed in the Mother. I had complete faith that if the Mother intervened, he would be completely healed.
I placed the covenant medal and a rosary in his hand, and I left.
After that, when it was the 75th day of my covenant here, I came again.
I said, “Mother, we see no change at all. Our child—Mother is giving wonders and signs to everyone. At this altar here,
I came and said this, and while I was standing here, I heard a voice from somewhere.
I heard the words, ‘You go.’ Crying, I went as far as the steps. Then I thought, ‘I didn’t fully say what I had come here to say,’ and I returned.
I came here again. When I came and looked, I said, “Mother, there are no signs or miracles. Each day the child is only becoming weaker, no change is coming.
Mother, you must intervene quickly.” While I was standing here praying with my eyes closed, again in a powerful voice,
it said to me, “You go, I will come.” Then I left from here and went home. By evening, Mother told me—when I had stood here and heard that voice,
I had again cried, and when I went home, my mother told me, “They have put the child back on the ventilator; there is no hope at all.” I said,
“Today I have gone to the Mother and said: when he recovers, after this ninety-day covenant is completed,
we must bring him here to this courtyard.” mother said, “There is no need to say such things now. That is not what we need.
Even if the child lies like this, it is enough if he can breathe at least a little.” I said, “That is not so, but what I am saying—
at that time, no one wanted to listen. We are also Hindus in our family.” Afterwards, in the evening, when I lay down, at this altar I saw a dream.
Father Joseph was there with four others. In front of the altar, four men stood, clothed in white down to their feet, with their beards tied.
Father was laying his hand on their heads, praying or doing something. I thought, “Something is going to happen to our child. That must be why I saw this dream.”
But I could not tell anyone, because I was afraid. If I told this at home, no one would understand, because everyone was already thinking something bad would happen to him.
Then suddenly, into my heart came the Lord who raised Lazarus. He came into my mind. The joy I felt at that moment—
even now I cannot explain it. Because this happened in 2023, I still cannot forget it.
Just like the angel of God raised Lazarus, God raised our child from there. After that, when he was taken for a bone marrow test, there was an experience.
He himself will say that. On the 87th day of my ninety-day covenant, we came here with him, to this altar, to this courtyard. That was a great miracle from the Mother.
Even the doctors had given up, but God gave him back to us. At that time, I could do nothing else but strengthen myself—
I did my missionary works and works of charity. I read the Word of God more strongly, prayed the rosary, and grew in prayer.
As part of charity works, wherever I went, the ones facing mental struggles were the ones who gave me comfort.
They were the ones who said, “When he is healed, bring him to us.” Otherwise, whoever spoke would only say,
“He will not survive. All you can do is pray that he may receive a peaceful death soon.”
They only told us to pray that he may receive a good death. After that, the experience he had, he will tell. They bent my back
and laid me down like a frog to do the bone marrow test. Inside that, they pierced my back and scraped it.
By piercing the back, they scraped and took out the marrow from the bone. When I was laid down like that, the pain was unbearable. But I had
a covenant medal my aunt had given me from here. Holding that in my hand, I lay on the operation table. As soon as they laid me down,
and began to pierce the bone, the pain was severe. I gripped that medal tightly in my hand to bear the pain. After a short while,
I no longer felt pain. But when I looked, on my side there was blood everywhere. Since they do not give us anesthesia,
we can clearly feel all the pain. But even though blood was flowing, I did not smell blood. Instead, I smelled a strong fragrance,
like jasmine flowers. I did not feel even a drop of pain. It was a very special experience for me.
After that, until today, I never again had to do another bone marrow test, nor did I have to take any medicines. In the most recent check-up,
when I went to the hospital, they said I still have no problems. Now, for about a year, I have been going to work, taking care of myself,
and looking after my home. Everything is going well. For all this, I give countless thanks to Mother and to Jesus. No matter how much I say, I cannot repay this debt.
As part of my missionary work, in the beginning, I used to take the magazine from here and give it to shops,
and also at the auto stand. Later on, it changed in my mind—now I take five bundles of the magazine, go to our perpetual adoration chapel,
recite the full rosary on my knees, and then distribute each copy to people. Every family that received the magazine, every person, and their children,
I now pray for and offer them. Then, as part of charity work, every month I prepare 25 food packets. We have a group dedicated to Kreupasanam Mother,
and through a person named Binu, we all cooperate together and carry it forward in a good way. Then the rosary—I never leave it incomplete.
No matter what work I have, only after finishing my rosary do I do the rest of my tasks. Likewise, with reading the Word of God—
I have now read the entire Bible six times, and I am currently up to the Psalms. No matter how much I say, it is not enough.
It was only through reading the Word of God that we received our child back. Because no one else gave us any good answer.
It was only through the Word that God revealed this to me. And likewise, during the time he was ill, my children—
Two people came with me to distribute the magazine, and as part of his recovery, everyone at their home had complete faith.
Both my children are now living in the covenant. For so many blessings I give countless thanks to the Holy Mother and to the Lord.
For my whole life — even if death comes — nothing in this world can separate me from the covenant; I am that deeply indebted to the Mother.
I thank God a thousand times for the life that has made it possible for me to stand here in this way.
From the Book of Wisdom 16:12,13: the scripture tells us it was not by potion, ointment, or medicine, but by Your word that healed them.
You have authority over life and death; You bring people down to the gates of the underworld and raise them up from there.
What we heard was the powerful testimony of Soja Shiju’s manifestation on behalf of this son afflicted by bone/blood cancer.
She took the covenant and prayed; medical science had given up, their finances had collapsed, and there was no possibility to continue treatment.
In great sorrow, thinking only the Holy Mother could intercede, she came, took the covenant and prayed — and a great miracle occurred.
This mother said here that no one can separate her from this covenant — as Saint Paul writes in his letter to the Corinthians: no one can separate me from Christ’s love.
We understand that only those who have experienced God’s love and faithfully lived the covenant can take on such a great challenge.
Let us all thank Jesus and the Holy Mother for this great miracle that we have witnessed.
Let us entrust to Jesus and the Holy Mother all those who pray for people suffering hopelessly from blood cancer, and present this testimony in their behalf.
May we offer this testimony as proof of God’s mercy — may such extraordinary divine experiences come to you as well.
